_comment: Central Government schemes for Persons with Disabilities. Scheme names, departments and portal URLs are public facts. Amounts and specific numeric thresholds are the best-known published values and are marked confidence_status=needs_verification — the system never presents these as verified without an official source. Always confirm against the official portal before applying.

schemes.official_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
schemes.description: Central sector scholarship to support the education of students with disabilities studying at the pre-matric level (up to class 10). Administered through the National Scholarship Portal.
schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefit_description: Maintenance allowance, books grant and disability allowance as per scheme rates.
schemes.official_contact: DEPwD, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

schemes.official_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
schemes.description: Central sector scholarship for students with disabilities pursuing post-matriculation (post-class 10) studies, administered through the National Scholarship Portal.
schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
schemes.benefit_description: Maintenance allowance, books grant and disability allowance.

schemes.official_name: Top Class Education for Students with Disabilities
schemes.description: Central sector scheme providing financial assistance to students with disabilities pursuing higher education in notified top-class institutions.
schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
schemes.benefit_description: Tuition fee, living expenses, books and stationery, and assistive device allowance.

schemes.official_name: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids/Appliances (ADIP)
schemes.description: Central scheme to assist persons with disabilities in procuring durable, scientifically manufactured aids and appliances through authorised camps and centres.
schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
schemes.benefit_description: Subsidised assistive devices (wheelchairs, hearing aids, prosthetics, orthotics, etc.) and fitting support.

rules.description: Income ceiling for full assistance (verify thresholds)

schemes.official_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
schemes.description: Component of the National Social Assistance Programme providing monthly pension to persons with severe and multiple disabilities below the poverty line.
schemes.benefit_description: Monthly pension to eligible persons with severe (80%+) disability.

schemes.official_name: National Fellowship for Persons with Disabilities
schemes.description: Fellowship to support students with disabilities pursuing MPhil and PhD in universities and research institutions recognised by the UGC.
schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
schemes.benefit_description: Fellowship stipend, contingency and escort/reader allowance.
